title: fail-closed: with both proxy signals unreadable the posture is unknown, never pass
why: The rule that makes the whole matrix trustworthy: a signal the collector cannot read is reported as unknown with the underlying error, never as pass and never as a guess about a third-party proxy's internal rules or a TUN tunnel's state. Both new probes are declared unavailable here (the same empty-string convention fault-tailscale-not-installed uses), so both checks must go unknown and the exit code must stay non-zero.
inject: registry.internet_settings and native.route_print4 both declared _available=false (the fixture-level 'the probe could not be read' marker), role=server

internet_settings._error: the registry read was refused for this case

route_print4._error: the route probe was unavailable for this case
